description: Agent Aviation Records: submit training and currency records with the pilot records and flight log they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each pilot record with its id, reference, name and the aircraft types and roles it lists; each training or checking event the record requires with its id, reference, pilot, the event and the moment due; each training completion entry with its id, reference, pilot, the event, the aircraft type and role trained for and the moment completed; each currency record with its id, reference, pilot, the currency item and the moment it lapses; each flight log entry with its id, reference, pilot and the moment flown. The signed report gives the pilots and the training file, each required event due by the reading moment against a completion entry, each flight against the pilot’s currency records on the day flown, and each training entry’s aircraft type and role against the pilot’s own record, and counts them, and names divergent training records: a training or checking event the record requires with no completion entry, a currency date already lapsed at the flight date, and training recorded for an aircraft or role the pilot’s own record does not list; then a training entry naming a pilot the pilot records do not hold and a flight by a pilot with no currency record on file, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No pilot records, requirements with due dates and no reading moment, or no currency records beside flights leaves those points unverified. Pilots match by reference or name and read as one when both name one pilot record, events, currency items and roles match by their words, aircraft types by letters and digits, a required event is due when its due date falls on or before the reading moment or it states none, and a currency item lapses after the day it states unless another record of the item is in force. This reads whether every required event was completed, every flight was flown current, and every training entry matches the pilot’s own record. Verdict aviation_training_record_divergent, aviation_training_record_partial, aviation_training_record_unverified or aviation_training_record_consistent. POST /api/aviation-training-record-check. Reads the aviation records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it flies no aircraft, inspects no aircraft in person, contacts no regulator, examiner or maintenance provider and issues no certification, which stay with the operator, its pilots, its mechanics and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Aviation Records reads an air operator’s own records: flight log records, aircraft maintenance records, airworthiness and directive records, inspection records, pilot certificate records, training and currency records, flight duty and rest records and incident report records, each against the fleet, maintenance, pilot and duty records, the mechanic, certificate and part records, the flight log and the maintenance record, the aircraft, operations and dates flown, the schedule and the corrective entries, the required events and the currency records, the operator’s own limits, or the follow-up entries on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the aircraft and the crew: what the flight log shows, what the maintenance record supports, what the certificates cover, and whether the duty and incident records hold up; it reads records about aircraft and crews, not live flight tracking and not travel booking: the Agent Travel family reads the bookings behind a trip, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records and the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file, while this family reads an air operator’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-aviation-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-aviation-records/.
